title: Benchmarks
description: Create reproducible tests, compare configurations, and inspect the evidence.
readOnlyTranscript: Benchmark evidence is read-only. Fork this chat to continue separately.

editor.title: Editor
editor.immutable: Publishing freezes the prompt, fixtures, evaluator, and environment. Future edits create a new version.
editor.leaveDescription: Your saved draft and published results will remain available.

context.title: Task and agent context
context.description: Declare the task inputs before running. Published context is frozen with the test.
context.structuredHelp: Entry state includes rootTaskId, stepId, parentStepId, fixtureSnapshotHash, conversationPrefix, previousReports and remainingBudgetSeconds. Workflow includes driverRevision and 2–4 steps with id, prompt and includePreviousOutput. Both use schemaVersion 1; entry contentHash is computed on save.

routing.title: Selector evidence
routing.description: Read compatible observations, coverage and freshness for caller-supplied candidates and constraints.
routing.availabilityUnknown: Current availability has not been verified
routing.eligibilityHelp: Saved candidates start unavailable. Explicitly set their current availability in the query. Use mode exact or class, purpose analysis or selector, and objective quality, latency or cost. Selector queries exclude their target family and held-out data.
routing.protocol: {{missing}} missing outcomes · shared time limit: {{seconds}} seconds

run.title: Run benchmarks
run.description: Choose a frozen test batch and pinned configurations. Review the execution count and budget before starting.
run.noPublished: Publish a test in Bench development before running it.
run.preview: Development preview. Excluded from official comparisons and baselines.

runs.title: Runs and history
runs.description: Pause finishes active attempts and stops new dispatch. Cancel also requests active cancellation.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Sealed output and evaluation revisions remain available independently of the live transcript.
evidence.blindReview: Model identity, measurements and transcript are hidden until the rubric review is recorded.

leaderboard.description: Compare the same frozen cases and budgets. Missing measurements stay unknown; incomplete coverage receives no comparable rank.
leaderboard.empty: No results match this selection. Publish and run a benchmark to collect evidence.

library.search: Search test names, categories, or families
library.empty: No tests yet. Create a test or import a definition.

nerf.description: Changes from the selected Distill baseline. Quality, duration, and output tokens remain separate measurements.
nerf.empty: Choose a repeated baseline and collect matched later runs to compare quality.

usage.description: Measured work per subscription allowance, by workload and quota window. Opening this view never starts a measurement.
usage.attribution: Quota belongs to the whole controlled batch. Mixed account activity cannot establish a task-specific charge. Missing telemetry is unknown, and an unreached limit is only a lower bound.
usage.empty: No quota samples for this selection. Run a published controlled measurement or bounded capacity profile.
usage.comparisonEmpty: Choose a repeated baseline to compare effective allowance.

baseline.title: Distill baseline
baseline.description: Freeze repeated completed runs and a meaningful effect threshold before comparing later observations.

import.title: Import a definition
import.description: Imported content becomes an editable draft. Import never runs setup commands.
import.tooLarge: Choose a definition smaller than 8 MiB.

export.title: Export benchmark dataset
export.description: Export the full outcome matrix and a versioned manifest. Account labels and credentials are excluded.
export.heldOut: Include held-out evaluation outcomes in this research export

schedules.title: Automatic retesting
schedules.description: Schedules run only while Distill is open. Missed work is shown for review; it does not launch a catch-up burst.
schedules.missed: Missed while the app was closed. Enable again to schedule the next run.
schedules.budget: Each run: at most {{executions}} executions, each limited to {{seconds}} seconds.
schedules.optIn: I explicitly enable automatic retesting with this fixed plan and budget.
schedules.discovery: Refresh models within a declared discovery scope
schedules.discoveryHelp: The selected run defines the calibration suite and existing native effort/fast settings. New candidates use reported native defaults. Every retest creates a new frozen plan under these limits.
schedules.modelIds: Allowed new model IDs (comma separated; empty allows all in scope)
schedules.includeNew: Allow calibration of newly discovered models in this scope
